nl_query: Which repositories are coupled with repository R_156018? Give me their repository identifiers, 25 at most.
I'd like the IDs of the repos that share a coupling relationship with the repo R_156018; please return no more than 25 of them.
Take repository R_156018 and look at its coupling relationships: list the identifiers of the repositories at the other end of those couplings, capped at 25 results.

Which pull requests resolve issue I_156018#12095? Show each pull request's identifier together with the time of the resolution event, sorted from the earliest resolution to the latest, and stop at 25 rows.
For issue I_156018#12095, list the PRs that resolved it, giving the PR ID and when each resolution took place, in ascending order of resolution time, limited to the first 25.

For issue I_156018#12095, could you put together a table of the pull requests that resolve it? I'd like two columns: each resolving pull request's identifier and the time its resolution of the issue took place, ordered from the earliest resolution time to the latest, with no more than 25 rows.

For pull requests whose IDs begin with PR_156018, take their links to external resources dated on or after 2023-01-01 and before 2024-01-01 (UTC) and group them by the link's registrable domain. For each domain show the distinct IDs of any actors those pull requests mention or reference (there may be none), the latest link time, and the number of distinct pull requests. Sort by pull request count descending, then by latest link time descending, top 30.

Which external domains did PR_156018-prefixed pull requests link to in 2023, meaning January 1, 2023 inclusive up to January 1, 2024 exclusive (UTC), judged by the time of the external link? Per domain (eTLD+1), report how many different pull requests linked there, when the most recent such link occurred, and the de-duplicated set of actor identifiers that those pull requests mention or reference, if they have any; pull requests without actor mentions or references still count. Rank by the number of pull requests, highest first, breaking ties with the most recent link time first, and keep 30 domains.

I need a per-domain summary, limited to 30 rows, with four columns: external-link domain, the collection of unique actor IDs, the newest external-link time, and the count of distinct pull requests. The scope is pull requests whose ID starts with PR_156018 and which link to an external resource, with the link time no earlier than 2023-01-01T00:00Z and strictly before 2024-01-01T00:00Z. Actors are optional extras, namely whichever actors a pull request mentions or references with no date restriction on those, and a pull request with none is still included. Order by the distinct pull request count descending, then by the newest link time descending.
For issue I_156018#12095, who opened it? Give me the actor ID, up to 25 results.
rendered_cypher: MATCH (i:Issue {entity_id: 'I_156018#12095'})-[rel:EVENT_ACTION]->(a:Actor) WHERE rel.service_rel_type = 'OPENED_BY' RETURN a.entity_id LIMIT 25

nl_query: Tell me which actor issue I_156018#12095 was opened by. I only need actor identifiers, capped at 25.
rendered_cypher: MATCH (i:Issue {entity_id: 'I_156018#12095'})-[rel:EVENT_ACTION]->(a:Actor) WHERE rel.service_rel_type = 'OPENED_BY' RETURN a.entity_id LIMIT 25

nl_query: I need the ID of whoever is recorded as the opener of the issue I_156018#12095; please list at most 25 actor IDs.
List up to 25 pull requests whose IDs start with PR_156018, showing just their IDs.
Which pull requests carry an identifier beginning with PR_156018? Return the identifiers, no more than 25.
I'm looking for pull request IDs that fall under the PR_156018 prefix; give me at most 25 of them.
What unknown-type objects does pull request PR_156018#11659 reference? Return their IDs, up to 25.
Pull request PR_156018#11659 refers to some objects whose type is unknown; give me the identifiers of those referenced objects, 25 at most.
rendered_cypher: MATCH (pr:PullRequest {entity_id: 'PR_156018#11659'})-[rel:REFERENCE]->(x:UnknownObject) WHERE rel.service_rel_type = 'REFERENCES' RETURN x.entity_id LIMIT 25

nl_query: Show me a list, maximum 25 entries, of the IDs of the untyped, unknown objects that are referenced from pull request PR_156018#11659.
Looking at comments made on issue I_156018#12095 on or after January 1, 2023 (UTC), which actors opened those comments? Give me the distinct actor IDs, limited to 25.
Who authored the issue comments that were posted to issue I_156018#12095 from 2023-01-01 00:00 UTC onward? I want each actor identifier only once, 25 at most.
Give me up to 25 unique actor IDs for the people who created comments on issue I_156018#12095, considering only comments whose commenting event on that issue is dated 2023-01-01 (UTC) or later.
For pull request PR_156018#11659, list the external resources it links to, giving each link's registrable domain and the resource ID; 10 results max.
Which outside resources are linked from pull request PR_156018#11659? Show the site domain (eTLD+1) of each link alongside the external resource's identifier, and stop at 10.
I'd like a two-column list, limited to 10 rows, of the link domain and the external-resource ID for every external resource that pull request PR_156018#11659 links to.
Which actors does issue comment IC_156018#12095#ic1 mention? Return their actor IDs, up to 25.
rendered_cypher: MATCH (ic:IssueComment {entity_id: 'IC_156018#12095#ic1'})-[rel:REFERENCE]->(a:Actor) WHERE rel.service_rel_type = 'MENTIONS' RETURN a.entity_id LIMIT 25

nl_query: Give me the identifiers of the actors who are mentioned in the issue comment IC_156018#12095#ic1, with a cap of 25.
Take issue comment IC_156018#12095#ic1 and list the actor ID of anyone it mentions, no more than 25 entries.

Among pull requests whose IDs begin with PR_156018, find references to unknown-type objects made on or after 2023-01-01 and before 2024-01-01 (UTC). Return the pull request ID and the unknown object ID, most recent reference first, top 50.

Show which unknown, untyped objects were referenced by PR_156018-prefixed pull requests during calendar year 2023, meaning from January 1, 2023 inclusive up to but not including January 1, 2024 (UTC). List each pull request's identifier with the referenced object's identifier, ordered from the latest reference to the earliest, 50 rows at most.

I need pairs of pull request ID and referenced unknown-object ID, sorted by reference time descending and limited to 50, where the pull request ID starts with PR_156018 and the reference itself happened no earlier than 2023-01-01T00:00Z and strictly earlier than 2024-01-01T00:00Z.

Take any item, of whatever kind, that mentions actor A_7045099. For that same item, which repositories does it mention and which external resources does it link to, if any? Return distinct repository ID and external resource ID pairs, leaving either side empty when it is missing, up to 50.

Starting from whatever mentions actor A_7045099, look up, independently and only where they exist, the repos mentioned by that same source and the external resources it links to. I want unique rows of repo ID plus external-resource ID, 50 at most; a source lacking a repo mention or an external link should still be kept.

What repositories and external resources show up alongside mentions of actor A_7045099? For each source of any type that mentions that actor, pair any repository the same source also mentions with any external resource the same source links to, where neither is required to be present, and return up to 50 distinct repository-ID and external-resource-ID pairs.

For pull request PR_156018#11659, count its links to external resources by registrable domain, considering only links dated on or after 2023-01-01 and before 2024-01-01 (UTC). Show each domain with its number of links, highest count first, top 20.

How many external-resource links did pull request PR_156018#11659 make to each site domain (eTLD+1) in 2023, that is, from January 1, 2023 inclusive to January 1, 2024 exclusive (UTC)? Tally every link rather than unique resources, and rank the domains from most to fewest links, keeping 20.

Break down by domain the links from pull request PR_156018#11659 to external resources whose link time is no earlier than 2023-01-01T00:00Z and strictly before 2024-01-01T00:00Z; I want the domain and the total number of links per domain, sorted by that number descending, limited to 20 domains.

Among pull requests with IDs starting with PR_156018 that mention actor A_7045099, find the ones that also link to an external resource where that link is dated on or after June 1, 2023 (UTC). Return the pull request ID and the link's registrable domain, newest link first, up to 50.

Which PR_156018-prefixed pull requests both mention the actor A_7045099 and contain an external-resource link made 2023-06-01 (UTC) or later? For each such link give the pull request identifier and the linked site's domain (eTLD+1), ordered by link time from latest to earliest, at most 50 rows.

I want up to 50 rows of pull request ID and external-link domain, sorted by the external link's time descending. Only include pull requests whose ID begins with PR_156018, that mention actor A_7045099, and that link to an external resource with that link's time being no earlier than 2023-06-01T00:00Z; the date condition is on the external link, not on the mention.

For issues whose IDs start with I_156018, find comments on those issues that reference a commit. Return the issue ID and the commit ID, ordered by the time of the comment's reference to the commit, newest first, limit 50.

Which commits are referenced from comments left on I_156018-prefixed issues? Pair each issue identifier with the commit identifier cited by one of its comments, sort by when the comment-to-commit reference was made (latest first), and return no more than 50.

Give me the 50 most recent commit references made in issue comments, restricted to comments on issues whose ID begins with I_156018; each row should show the issue ID and the referenced commit ID, and recency means the time of the reference to the commit, descending.

For pull request PR_156018#11659, look at the reviews created in it and the review comments made on those reviews. Which actors do those review comments mention or reference, where the mention or reference is dated on or after 2023-01-01 and before 2024-01-01 (UTC)? Return distinct actor IDs, up to 50.

Who gets mentioned or referenced in review comments attached to reviews that were created in pull request PR_156018#11659? Only consider mentions or references of an actor that occurred during 2023, January 1, 2023 inclusive through January 1, 2024 exclusive (UTC), and give each actor identifier once, 50 at most.

List up to 50 unique actor IDs such that a review comment either mentions or references the actor at a time no earlier than 2023-01-01T00:00Z and strictly before 2024-01-01T00:00Z, the review comment was made on a review, and that review was created in pull request PR_156018#11659. The date range applies to the actor mention or reference only.
